A due-south file, constant east coordinate with changing north depth, therefore projects to a ray from the image centre outward. A point on the back wall must appear closer to the centre than the point in the same file on the grass in front, by Z-back divided by Z-front.

In the 8 s frontal the spinner's head is about 140-150 original pixels east of the centre. A pole held horizontally and pointed due south, i.e. perpendicular to the wall and to the front line, stays in that vertical north-south plane. Its tip, if long enough to reach the grass line, therefore arrives at that head.
